dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Jets Secure Third Win Behind Defensive Pressure and Shepard’s Two Scores
dailyTopNewsBrief.summary: New York improved to 3-8 following a 27-24 road victory over the Los Angeles Chargers, fueled by a six-sack defensive performance and efficient red-zone execution. Despite the win, the Jets remain mathematically distant from playoff contention with a 2.1% probability as they prepare for a Week 12 divisional matchup against the 1-9 Miami Dolphins.
bullets: Edge rusher David Bailey recorded two sacks against Justin Herbert in his return to the West Coast, contributing to a defensive front that pressured the Chargers throughout the contest [S1](https://www.newyorkjets.com/news/california-native-david-bailey-sacks-justin-herbert-twice-in-return-to-the-west-coast-11-22-2026)

Quarterback Geno Smith engineered three touchdown drives, connecting twice with practice squad elevation Sterling Shepard and once with Breece Hall to secure the three-point victory [S13](https://www.newyorkjets.com/news/geno-smith-jets-engineers-3-touchdown-drives-in-victory-over-chargers-11-22-2026)

The defensive unit, led by coordinator Brian Duker, finished with six total sacks, a critical performance for a group that currently ranks #26 in Defensive EPA allowed per game [S12](https://www.newyorkjets.com/news/jets-chargers-game-recap-11-22-2026)

Head Coach Aaron Glenn emphasized the team's resilience in the winning locker room, though New York must now address a rush defense ranked #30 league-wide before facing Miami [S14](https://www.newyorkjets.com/video/jets-locker-room-win-speech-game-balls-vs-chargers-11-23-2026)
